args: Implement docs/plans/building-code-plan.md using only data already in the repository (no new acquisition): record the baseline release and commit; open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 one schema version, shared documents stored once, data and map tiles out of git with range requests verified, per-chapter loading within the page budgets, cross-document search, accurate declarations, browser tests in CI; Part 2 full consolidated documents per corporation and date, with bye-law 1.4 modelled as incorporation instead of substitution; Part 3 parameter records for coverage, FAR (base, premium, TDR), setbacks, height and parking parsed from the existing tables with numeric intervals, conditions and cell-level sources, plus a 40-record page-image self-check; Part 4 resolution.yaml with the six cited steps, a deterministic resolver in pipeline and browser, the Jayanagar 600 m² / 15 m road worked target confirmed against page images, relations rebuilt with only amends, incorporates and corporation_differs public and a 60-item labelling sheet; Part 5 map-first home with the Protomaps light style, labels above zones, official RMP legend colours, place and ward search, plot card with answers, reasons, page links and "not settled" cases, resolution cards and short plain copy; Part 6 Model Building Bye-laws 2017 marked not applicable here and all gaps declared in plain words; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md resumable and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections current; never invent source content, never mark anything as verified by a person.
